name: Bricking Point
author: marchmiskin
description:
This is absolutely not what I intended to submit to the GameJam showcase.  I had been working on a LEGO RPG, I had it all wrapped up and ready to go just by the Game Jam deadline, and... I couldn't upload it.  I got a server error.  And for some reason I couldn't upload it to the GameJam site directly either.  So I panicked and selected to enter this game that I haven't worked on for several weeks instead.  Dang it.  If you want to see what I tried to upload, it's at kamawale.net/MonstersAndMinifigs, though... it's an enormous file, which is probably why I couldn't upload it.  Not sure how well it's going to play as a WebGL game anyway, to be honest.  Still... I'm kind of frustrated at having put in all that work on my game and not being able to enter it in the GameJam.  Oh well.

Oh, dang.  I'm such an idiot.  I just realized this isn't even the game I worked on recently.  This is the one I did months ago when I was first trying out the LEGO Microgame.  Oops.  Dang.  I am dumb.
